cells.value: Starlight FAQ:  Starlight seems to be a honorary PRF for Aurora-adjacent characters. Cai has a version of it as a combat skill on his Supreme Arc, Aurora has access to it as a guest. Supposedly Ultand had a version of it in the trailer but does not have access to it in-game. Ergo, the only playable character that naturally has it is Orchel. Based off of this we can only assume (as of now) that Starlight is an honorary PRF for Orchel.
